( 04 )The Flooff Standard

Four gates. Nobody can pay to skip one.

Before any provider joins the Flooff network, they clear every one of these.

Legal standing

Valid UAE trade licence, checked before any provider joins the network.

Professional credentials

Veterinary registration, grooming certification and handling qualifications, confirmed at source.

Operational history

Facility standards and years in operation, reviewed before onboarding.

Ongoing performance

Every booking leaves a service record. Providers falling below standard come out of the network.

No paid placement, ever

No paid tier, no promoted placement, no advertising product. If that ever changes, it will be said here first.

Encrypted and private

WhatsApp conversations are end-to-end encrypted. We don't sell your data or share it beyond the provider you're booking with.

He anticipates.

Frequently Asked Questions

Pet Butler is named after a real dog. Duke is big, black, extremely goofy, and devoted to looking after dogs smaller than himself. Operationally, Pet Butler is an intelligent assistant living inside WhatsApp who coordinates your pet's care.

Yes. You pay the provider's own price, through us — no booking fee, no service charge, nothing added on top. We earn from partnerships with the providers in our network, not from you.

No. No provider can pay to rank — no promoted placement, no featured tier, at any price. He recommends on fit, availability, and how that provider has actually performed for other pets.

He'll gather the details and hand you to a human specialist. For anything intricate — an unusual medical history, international travel paperwork — a person reviews it before anything is confirmed. He's built to know when to stop.

Tell him. A person picks it up, we help resolve it with the provider, and it goes on that provider's record. Because payment runs through us, we can put things right directly. Providers who consistently fall short come out of the network.

Always. Just type "human". Anything unusual goes to a human specialist anyway, and every booking is confirmed by a person before it's final.
